polish.notes: Arin is dry, exact and impatient; she says what she means in few words.

send_generate.text: I knock on the archive door. "Arin? It's us. We need the old harbour ledger."
"Come on, you know me. Five minutes inside, that's all." I hold up the guild token.
I look at the narrow window beside the door. What can I see through it?
"Who else has asked for that ledger this week, Arin?"
I wait by the door, watching her face. "You're nervous. Why?"
"If the ledger is gone, someone took it. Help us find out who."
I offer her the silver coin the harbourmaster gave us. "For your trouble."
What does the street behind us look like right now?
"Fine. What would it take for you to open this door?"
I tell her quietly: "Nobody will know you helped us."
